why_new: The 2025 article describes v6.1 but Borealis latestVersion is dataset version 4.0 released 2026-02-11 and supplies files explicitly labeled PROCEEDv6.2. Do not silently treat v6.2 as v6.1, assume same records, or pool versions.
allowed_operations: GET Borealis official dataset file access URL of exact frozen 5 file IDs; extract first UTF-8 TSV header line only and close stream without reading response rows.
Inspect whether rate table declares an original study, population/source locality, original longitude/latitude, common-garden or genetic design, time between sample events and trait type.
Inspect taxonomy and species generation-time file headers, not row values; do not use generation time to post-hoc select taxa.
Emit column names, file identity, source version, header status only.
prohibited: Read per-row Haldane/Darwin rate, genotype, climate, phenotype data
fit any biological history, adaptation or plasticity effect
mix v6.1 published counts (9263, 428) with v6.2 count inferred from filenames
rewrite the TTF-Q or frozen genetic endpoints
if_no_actual_collection_coordinates: Species-range environmental exposure can only be a newly declared different estimand, not a substitute for individual population LGM history
